rec.name: Live Chat Widget with FAQ, AI Answers & WhatsApp (Chatty)
rec.status: In configuration, app deactivated until setup is finished

what.text: A site-wide live-chat widget from the Shopify app "Chatty". Shoppers get instant help through a prefilled FAQ and AI-generated answers. The chat can also be linked to the store owner's WhatsApp so conversations continue there. The widget text must be fully localized to German.

why.text: Shoppers can get an answer to a purchase question (shipping, returns, sizing, product details) without leaving the page or waiting for email. This removes doubt at the moment it arises and reduces drop-off. A visible, reachable human channel such as WhatsApp signals a trustworthy shop. FAQ and AI answers deliver this support at scale without staffing a live agent at all times.

how.text: 1) Install the Chatty app and keep it deactivated until setup is complete. 2) Translate all remaining English UI strings to German. 3) Write further FAQ questions and answers. 4) Set up some AI answers. 5) Connect WhatsApp, which needs about 15 minutes with the account owner present. 6) Adjust the key settings, then test the full flow, including WhatsApp, before re-activating the app on the live store.

items: Widget language and all UI texts (German translation)
Other app settings (the ticket mentions numerous options but does not list them)

dependencies.text: Third-party Shopify app "Chatty" (live chat). Needs a WhatsApp account that can be linked, and the account owner must be available for the connection. No theme code or metafields are mentioned. The app must be enabled in the Shopify theme/app embeds to show.

items: Chat open rate and conversations started
FAQ and AI answer resolution rate
Conversion rate of chat users vs. non-chat users
Exit rate on PDP and cart
